== Summary ==
Identified: none. Friday team-event hall. At the near table: a smiling player in a white tank top with tattoos, holding a card; a teammate in a green shirt; a player in an orange shirt and glasses, seen from behind; and a player in a magenta shirt at right, in profile. Other tables in the background. Faces unlabeled.
The team event on Friday of the [[2023 European Championship]] (14 teams).
